title: JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA Review: Good vs Bad | IDE Guide
voiceover_script: Thinking about trying JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA? Let's break down the good, the bad, and who it's actually best for in 60 seconds! JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA is a powerful enterprise java / polyglot ide. On the positive side, Unrivaled refactoring, static code analysis, and smart code completion.; First-class framework integration (Spring, Jakarta EE, React, Angular).. However, keep in mind: Heavy RAM and CPU resource consumption on huge monorepos.; Steep learning curve with extensive toolbars and configuration panels.. Pricing structure is Freemium (Free Community / Paid Ultimate). Our verdict: Enterprise Java, Kotlin, and full-stack developers requiring top-tier refactoring and deep static analysis..
